title: chore: add Pullfrog workflow file
body:
This PR adds the `.github/workflows/pullfrog.yml` workflow file to enable [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) agent runs in this repository.

Once merged, return to the [Pullfrog console](https://pullfrog.com/console/niway-dev/kaipu-record) and click **Verify workflow** to finish setup.
